task_instance: Triage a sample Mutual NDA between Acme Robotics, Inc. and Northwind Supply Co. (created as realistic sample input in sample_nda.txt) against the skill's standard screening criteria, using default market-standard playbook values (no legal.local.md was present), and produce a structured NDA Triage Report classifying it GREEN/YELLOW/RED with screening table, issues found, and recommended next steps.
evidence: Created /tmp/.../exec_gr/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__triage-nda@offline-workstation/sample_nda.txt, a realistic mutual NDA containing deliberate issues (overbroad confidential-information catch-all, missing independent-development carveout, and an embedded employee non-solicitation clause) to exercise the skill's triage logic against several severity tiers. Confirmed no legal.local.md or other NDA playbook existed in the work directory (ls -la showed only the two files I created), so applied the skill's documented default screening criteria per Step 2. Manually walked the NDA through all 10 Step-3 screening categories from SKILL.md and applied the Step-4 GREEN/YELLOW/RED classification rules, then wrote the full deliverable to triage_report.md following the exact Step-5 report template (Classification/Parties/Type/Term/Governing Law/Review Basis header, Screening Results table, Issues Found with What/Risk/Suggested Fix per issue, Recommendation, Next Steps). Classified the sample RED (non-solicitation clause + missing independent-development carveout are both explicit RED triggers in the skill), with two additional YELLOW-level issues (overbroad definition, missing retention exception) also documented, matching the skill's rule that RED issues co-existing with YELLOW issues still yield a RED classification. Verified deliverable exists: `ls -la` shows sample_nda.txt (32 lines) and triage_report.md (63 lines); `grep -c RED triage_report.md` = 5 occurrences confirming the classification and RED-tagged issues are present and internally consistent with the input document's actual clauses (re-checked each report line against the source NDA text). No network access, external tools, connectors, or credentials were needed at any point -- this is a pure text-analysis and document-generation task fully achievable with local reading/reasoning/file-writing.
